findings.source: new Hypervisor{salt: ...}(pool, owner(), name, symbol)  (ABI encoding of the two string constructor arguments)
findings.issue: The two identical string encodings are rendered differently: name (at a constant address) as one copy line, symbol (at an address depending on name.length) as a word loop with a padding mask (P7).
findings.rule: A word loop mem[d + i] = mem[s + i] for i < n step 32, followed by masking the last partial word, is the copy mem[d len n] = mem[s len n] with zero padding, whatever the (symbolic) base addresses.
